reserves.issuerOrObligor: Circle Internet Financial, Inc. and the legacy Plume USDC.e bridge route

reserveReview.rationale: Plume's current documentation identifies pUSD as a 1:1 USDC wrapper and lists native USDC plus legacy USDC.e on Plume. Same-run reads at Ethereum block 26024690 (2026-09-21T08:26:59Z) found 13,766.187387 pUSD and 121,832.026881 native USDC in the BoringVault. At Plume block 94614492 (2026-09-21T08:27:00Z), the vault held 1,670,947.471881 native USDC and 678,668.342749 USDC.e against 2,457,681.655773 pUSD. Across both deployments, 2,471,447.841511 USDC claims reconcile to 2,471,447.843160 pUSD (0.001649-token difference); the normalized mix is 72.53964533% native USDC and 27.46035467% bridged USDC.e. The bridged slice remains medium for the additional bridge contract path.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-documented USDC-only composition reconciled from pUSD totalSupply and BoringVault token balances at timestamp-aligned Ethereum and Plume blocks
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unresolved reserve constituent exposure in the issuer-documented and on-chain-reconciled composition.
